purpose: post-design validation admission; no model results; not cross-repository generalization

selection.method: purposive three-case batch covering usage formatting, binary output and color validation; not random sampling
selection.eligibility: merged Click behavioral fix; not among seven development tasks; public reproduction; pinned parent/fix commits; pure Python; standard-library checks on Windows
selection.retention: retain every candidate and exclusion reason; do not replace candidates based on repair outcomes
selection.construction: Constructor reviewed public reports and upstream patches for scoring; no new retrieval or prompt tuning. Model pretraining contamination is unknown.

cases.public_problem: HelpFormatter.write_usage must emit the usage prefix and program name when args is empty, without a trailing separator space or extra blank line. Preserve custom prefixes and normal nonempty argument rendering. Commands with no parameters and empty or None options_metavar must still show their usage line.

echo must accept empty bytes and bytearray messages with newline enabled on binary output streams, writing a binary newline without TypeError. Preserve nonempty binary output, nl=False, text output, None messages and string conversion of ordinary objects.

style and secho must honor palette index 0 for both foreground and background. Invalid colors must raise ValueError: unknown names, booleans, out-of-range palette indices, and RGB sequences without exactly three non-boolean integer components in 0..255. Preserve named colors, valid palette/RGB colors, reset behavior and plain output when color is disabled.
